method.reason: For the fixed-geometry GIAO shielding of the 3-atom HCN system, PBE0 is a hybrid DFT choice permitted by the request; it generally provides a balanced description for shielding tensors while remaining affordable for one small molecule. RHF would be cheaper but is a lower-level treatment for correlation-sensitive shielding; PBE0 is selected with cost and accuracy in mind.
